official: 八王子市長房ふれあい館条例の一部を改正する条例設定について
committee: 予算等審査特別委員会
name: 長房ふれあい館の部屋の利用料金を改定
summary: 長房ふれあい館の各部屋について、条例に定める全日利用料金の金額が改定されます。2027年4月1日から、集会室1・2は各2,800円、会議室は11,300円などになります。実際の利用料金は、条例に定める金額の範囲内で指定管理者が定めます。
changes: 条例別表の集会室1・2の全日利用額を各1,900円から2,800円に改める
条例別表の会議室の全日利用額を8,200円から11,300円に改める
条例別表の娯楽室の全日利用額を5,000円から6,600円に改める
条例別表の多目的室2・3と創作室の全日利用額を、それぞれ6,900円から9,300円、3,800円から5,000円、3,200円から4,400円に改める
who: 長房ふれあい館の対象施設を利用する人

en.name: Revises room-use fees at Nagafusa Fureai Hall
en.official: Regarding the Establishment of an Ordinance Partially Amending the Hachioji City Nagafusa Fureai Hall Ordinance
en.summary: The all-day fees for the rooms at Nagafusa Fureai Hall, as set out in the ordinance, will be revised. From April 1, 2027, the fee will be ¥2,800 each for Assembly Rooms 1 and 2, ¥11,300 for the Conference Room, and other amounts. The designated manager sets the actual fees within the amounts set out in the ordinance.
changes: Raises the all-day fee listed in the ordinance's schedule for Assembly Rooms 1 and 2 from ¥1,900 to ¥2,800 each
Raises the all-day fee listed in the ordinance's schedule for the Conference Room from ¥8,200 to ¥11,300
Raises the all-day fee listed in the ordinance's schedule for the Recreation Room from ¥5,000 to ¥6,600
Raises the all-day fees listed in the ordinance's schedule for Multipurpose Rooms 2 and 3 and the Creative Room from ¥6,900 to ¥9,300, from ¥3,800 to ¥5,000, and from ¥3,200 to ¥4,400, respectively
who: People who use Assembly Room 1 or 2 at Nagafusa Fureai Hall
People who use the Conference Room at Nagafusa Fureai Hall
People who use the Recreation Room at Nagafusa Fureai Hall
People who use Multipurpose Room 2 or 3 or the Creative Room at Nagafusa Fureai Hall
